data.name: Christophorus
data.gender_notes: Christophorus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek words 'Christos' (anointed) and 'phoros' (carrier), Christophorus symbolizes carrying or bearing Christ. The name Christophorus carries the meaning “Christ-bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Christophorus usually hope their child will grow to embody christ-bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of faith and devotion, carrying the spiritual burdens of others.
data.etymology: Christophorus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Christ-bearer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Christophorus total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: כריסטופורוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם כריסטופורוס מורכב מיוונית 'Χριστός' (המשיח) ו'φορέας' (נושא). הוא מתייחס לאדם שנושא או נושאת את המשיח בלבו, ומבטא את המחויבות לשאת את בשורת המשיח לעולם.

in_greek.name: Χριστόφορος
in_greek.meaning: Χριστός + φορός: ο αυτός που φέρει τον Χριστό
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χριστόφορος προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'Χριστός' (ο Messiah) και 'φορός' (φορέας), δηλώνοντας εκείνον που φέρει ή μεταφέρει τον Χριστό. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με τον Άγιο Χριστόφορο, ο οποίος θεωρείται προστάτης των ταξιδιωτών και των οδηγών.

in_latin.name: Christophorus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Christophorus derivatur ex vocabulis Latinis 'Christus' (unguentus, Messias) et 'ferens' vel 'portans' (qui fert, qui portat). Significat igitur illum qui Christum in corde suo gestat et vitam suam secundum praecepta eius disponit.

in_english.name: Christophorus
in_english.long_meaning: The name Christophorus originates from the Greek words 'Χριστός' (Christ) and 'φορός' (bearer). It signifies one who bears or carries Christ, reflecting a deep spiritual commitment to follow and spread the teachings of Jesus Christ. Historically, Saint Christopher is one of the most revered bearers of this name, known as the patron saint of travelers.

data.cultural_impact: In medieval Europe, Christophorus was represented as a muscular man, carrying a Christ child across a river on his shoulder. He was often depicted as carrying a large cross to signify the burden of Christian faith. Christophorus has been revered as the patron saint of travelers and those who have heavy burdens to bear, and he is still celebrated with feast days in some Christian denominations.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Christophorus' holds a profound spiritual significance as it symbolizes the carrying of Christ in one's heart and actions. It is a reminder that as believers, we are called to bear the burden of our faith and spread the message of love and salvation offered by Jesus Christ. The name is a constant reminder of the sacrifice and love that Jesus showed in carrying the cross for us and the entire humanity.
